# Create Projectile

Source: [5175](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/5175); edited 2025-02-23. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create Projectile](../../api/actions/create-projectile.md).

<a id="wiki-5175-n1"></a>

- Projectile entities heal/damage players and owned entities, fail at entity capacity, and never affect the owner regardless of affected team.

<a id="wiki-5175-n2"></a>

- Null owner means no kill credit; null start/direction use the player's eye position/facing. Relativity affects both position and direction.

<a id="wiki-5175-n3"></a>

- Amount Scalar is a critical-hit multiplier at zero explosion radius, but edge-of-explosion damage at positive radius; explosion visual/sound are absent with zero radius.

<a id="wiki-5175-n4"></a>

- Oversize spans 0–1 with type-specific maximum; speed is meters/second, lifetime seconds; explosion impulse affects all explosion targets.

<a id="wiki-5175-n5"></a>

- Ricochet Count counts environment bounces before expiry; negative gravity makes projectiles arc upwards; extension unlocks more projectile types.
